target.purpose: Compile supplied hold residuals into one deterministic, policy-bound human+machine explanation without losing codes, ownership, severity, tied details, or unknown subsystems.
target.central_bottleneck: Operational hold evidence becomes ambiguous when duplicate residuals are order-dependent, malformed severity/identity values are accepted, or the prioritization policy behind the primary reason is not bound into the receipt.
success: Equal highest-severity duplicate details are preserved deterministically.
Severity precedes subsystem priority and ties are deterministic.
Unknown subsystems remain visible as unassigned.
Policy fingerprint is bound into the complete machine brief receipt.
The compiler never claims hold-clearance or flight-decision authority.

invariants: severity must be LOW HIGH or CRITICAL
unknown subsystems are visible not dropped
terminal fingerprint binds the complete machine brief

donors.boundary: future mission decision receipts may be cited by hold explanations, but no exercised integration exists yet

nonclaims: does not decide or clear launch holds
does not authenticate upstream residuals or actuate hardware
